blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — For returning Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) displaced by escalating tensions in the Middle East, homecoming brings both safety and daunting financial uncertainty. To ease this transition, the Iloilo City Government has extended cash aid and comprehensive economic reintegration support to 64 repatriated workers and seafarers. During the third phase of distribution on Wednesday, October 28, local officials released P10,000 in immediate financial assistance to 22 returning OFWs, bringing the total number of beneficiaries supported by the city to 64 following earlier releases to batches of 24 and 18 recipients.
